title: ChroPlate - ProteinA
author: Alexandra Ehl
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8qphvvn

steps.title: Prepare sample buffer
steps.instruction: Adjust sample pH to 7.5‑8.5 and ionic strength to 150‑300 mM NaCl by adding 1/11 volume of 0.5 M Tris, 2 M NaCl (pH 8.0) to the sample before loading.

steps.title: Assemble vacuum device
steps.instruction: If using vacuum filtration, assemble the vacuum device according to the manufacturer’s instructions before proceeding.

steps.title: Load sample onto ChroPlate
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate. Add up to 1.5 ml sample to each well. For centrifugation: centrifuge 5 min at 400 g in a swing‑out rotor (longer for >1 ml or viscous samples). For vacuum: apply 100 mbar vacuum for 2‑3 min (longer for >1 ml or viscous samples). Keep flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE).

steps.title: Wash plate (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Empty the deep‑well plate or place the ChroPlate on a clean one. Add 500 µl wash buffer to each well (optionally include up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl to reduce nonspecific interactions). Place the ChroPlate on a deep‑well plate (use the dummy filter plate provided for counter‑balance) and centrifuge 2 min at 400 g in a swing‑out rotor. Repeat this wash two additional times (three washes total) for increased purity.

steps.title: Wash plate (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Empty the deep‑well plate or place the ChroPlate on a clean one. Add 500 µl wash buffer to each well (optionally up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl; note that Tween can cause frothing under vacuum). Place the ChroPlate on a waste receptacle and apply 100 mbar vacuum for 2 min. Repeat this wash two additional times (three washes total) for increased purity.

steps.title: Elute protein (centrifuge)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate. Add 300 µl elution buffer to each well and centrifuge 2 min at 400 g in a swing‑out rotor. Repeat the elution two more times (three elutions total).

steps.title: Elute protein (vacuum)
steps.instruction: Place the ChroPlate on a clean deep‑well plate. Add 100 µl elution buffer to each well and apply 100 mbar vacuum for 2 min. Repeat the elution two more times (three elutions total).

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add one drop of neutralization solution to every well of the deep‑well plate and mix gently.

steps.title: Method preference note
steps.instruction: Centrifugation is recommended over vacuum filtration because vacuum can cause excessive frothing, especially when Tween‑20 is present in the wash buffer.
